$comment: THE CONTROL PANEL. Edit this file on GitHub and every BD's overlay picks
the change up within 10 minutes — no extension reinstall, no deploy, no
developer. Commit to main and you're done.
company — what the overlay shows on a company record. Column names must
match the `Company List` Airtable table exactly. A name that
doesn't exist is skipped silently, so a typo costs a missing
row, not a broken panel. Click 'Show all fields' at the bottom
of the overlay to see the real column names.
If this file is unreachable or malformed, the extension falls back to the
copies bundled in extension/config/. Nothing breaks; you just lose remote
control until it's valid again. CI validates it on every push.

_fields_comment: A value may be a column name, a LIST of candidate names (first one
present on the record wins), or { field, type }. Use a list when you
aren't sure what the column is called — a name that matches nothing
is skipped, so extra candidates cost nothing and a wrong guess costs
a missing row rather than a broken panel. Click 'Show all fields' at
the bottom of the overlay to read the real names off a record, then
trim these lists to the one that's right.

buckets.label: Connect today
buckets._rule_comment: "nextCallDue" = the account's next call date is today or already past. Use "nextCallToday" instead for today only — but then a call you missed last week shows up nowhere by date.

queue._groupBy_comment: "account" buckets companies; "contact" buckets individual contacts. An account's stage is the BEST stage any of its contacts has reached — the same rule kylas-airtable-sync uses for Account Pipeline Stage (BD), so the overlay and the sync never disagree about where an account is.
accountStageOrder: Discovery Call Done - Awaiting Client Inputs
queue._accountColumns_comment: Which Company List columns the queue reads. Names come from kylas-airtable-sync's config/field_map.json — rename a column in Airtable and change it here, no extension release needed.
_nextCall_comment: "nextCall" is OPTIONAL and is the one column the queue can start without.
Next Call Date lives on the CONTACT in Kylas; kylas-airtable-sync's
account-health module rolls it up onto the company as the EARLIEST date
any of its contacts is due, and writes it here. Until that sync has run,
the column doesn't exist — Airtable 422s the whole request for one
unknown field, so the extension retries without it and hides the
"Connect today" bucket rather than showing it permanently empty.
